# nowplaying-cli

Release builds bundle `nowplaying-cli` 2.1.0 from:

https://github.com/kirtan-shah/nowplaying-cli

Pinned source commit:

`8c8c1fa4820681fd4bbd6a17ce0a5655e1f4ebe7`

The dependency is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. The release build includes
the complete license and the corresponding source archive alongside the
executable.

Generated binaries and source archives are intentionally not committed.
Run `Scripts/prepare-bundled-cli.sh`, or build the Xcode target, to prepare
the Universal `arm64` + `x86_64` bundle.
